Justice GORSUCH delivered the opinion of the Court.
The Federal Arbitration Act requires courts to enforce private arbitration agreements. But like most laws, this one bears its qualifications. Among other things, § 1 says that "nothing herein" may be used to compel arbitration in disputes involving the "contracts of employment" of certain transportation workers.
